page.overview:
Who is Thimble?

is a pixie rogue played by Laura Bailey in Campaign Four.

Thimble is a four-inch-tall pixie, who appears to be about 18 years old. She has short brown hair (with a single short braid to honor Teor Pridesire), sparkly freckles, and ordinarily has spring-green wings, with eyes of that same color. She wears dark green clothing and a large button at her waist, has an industrial piercing in her right ear, and carries two needles as swords. She smells like honeysuckle, and the scent feels effervescent and otherworldly. The pixie dust on her usually gives her a spring-green golden glow, although the color and intensity of the glow can change depending of the situation,, where Brennan described how the presence of a lot of cold iron and symbols of the Candescent Creed in Tybry's Lea made Thimble's light diminish.}} and she can suppress it completely, if she so wishes.

Thimble is a stone cold killer with a history, and the kind of person who'd start a bar fight. She's a warrior pixie, and a badass who doesn't take any shit. Campaign 4 Ep 1-4 Recap]"| vod=https://youtu.be/hdLPwuKMlIY | 11:52}}

She cares deeply for her close friends, evident when she broke down into tears having heard she failed to save Thjazi. Her priority now is trying to make it right by causing suffering to anybody that did that to him. She believes that if she finishes what Thjazi started, "maybe then I'll feel better." Campaign 4 Ep 1-4 Recap]" | vod=https://youtu.be/hdLPwuKMlIY | 12:32}}
